newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket - Australia win toss and decide to bat.
newsitem.headline: Cricket - Australia win toss and decide to bat.

text.p: Australia captain Mark Taylor won the toss and elected to bat in the second test against West Indies at the Sydney Cricket Ground on Friday.
Australia fast bowler Jason Gillespie is making his test debut after paceman Paul Reiffel was relegated to 12th man.
West Indies named the same side that lost the first test by 123 runs in Brisbane on Tuesday.

Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Matthew Elliott, Ricky Ponting, Mark Waugh, Greg Blewett, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Michael Kasprowicz, Jason Gillespie, Glenn McGrath, Paul Reiffel 12th man

West Indies - Sherwin Campbell, Robert Samuels, Brian Lara, Carl Hooper, Shivnarine Chanderpaul, Jimmy Adams, Courtney Browne, Ian Bishop, Kenneth Benjamin, Curtly Ambrose, Courtney Walsh (captain), Adrian Griffith 12th man.
